sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: official online application and FAQ
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / e-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government eVisa portal identifies itself as the official Chadian eVisa platform. It says non-exempt foreigners may submit online, recommends filing at least seven days before entry, and describes an eVisa as issued before travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ce site permet à tout étranger non exempté de visa de soumettre sa demande d’e-Visa en ligne.

sources.title: Travel advice and advisories for Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: Current Canadian government Chad travel advice, last updated 20 August 2026, distinguishes a regular Canadian passport and says a tourist visa is required; the page-level date is not treated as the visa subsection's amendment date.

sources.title: Overseas Safety Travel: Chad country information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Foreign Affairs country page distinguishes ordinary passports, marks visa-free entry unavailable and says entry is refused when arriving without a visa.

policies.title: Chad eVisa: confirmed Canadian and Republic of Korea ordinary passports
policies.summary: Current Canadian and Republic of Korea government travel authorities establish that ordinary short visitors need a Chad visa. Chad’s current official notices require new visa applications exclusively through evisa.td before travel.
conditions: Applies only to ordinary Canadian and Republic of Korea passports for short visitor travel.

Chad’s official portal requires non-exempt foreigners to apply online; its 11 May 2026 notice makes evisa.td the exclusive channel for new visas, with outside-platform visas invalid after 21 May 2026.

The 4 June 2026 circular states 10 working days for standard processing and 72 hours for express processing. Approval, documentary, health, security and final border-admission checks remain applicable.
Does not cover diplomatic, official, service, residence, work, transit, crew, refugee, special-document, dual-nationality or other conditional routes.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express, according to the 4 June 2026 circular.
steps: Submit the official eVisa application online before travel.
Provide the passport and requested supporting documents, then pay as directed.
Travel only after issuance; final admission remains for Chadian immigration authorities.
